component.name: Loxone Config
component.summary: Design and simulate building automation projects

description.p: Design automation projects for Loxone installations. Organize rooms and devices, connect function blocks, and simulate automation logic before deploying it to a Miniserver.
This package runs the official Windows release using Wine.
The interface follows your desktop scale by default. If the text or controls are too small, choose a larger size. Restart Loxone Config after changing the setting.

ul.li: Example for larger text and controls: flatpak run --command=cellar com.loxone.Config config dpi=168
Restore automatic scaling: flatpak run --command=cellar com.loxone.Config config dpi=auto

screenshot.caption: Simulating an inverted digital input connected to a relay
